note: Charlotte seed list compiled 2026-11-25 from public listings. Dog policies, hours and fees change: each entry links to its source and should be checked before visiting. Entries have addresses, not coordinates.

places.name: Frazier Park Dog Park
places.note: County dog park, 1.3 acres, fenced, with separate areas for small and large dogs and a water supply. Next to the Irwin and Stewart Creek greenways.

places.name: Davie Dog Park
places.note: County dog park in William R. Davie Park, about 5 acres, fenced, with separate areas for large and small dogs and shaded on-leash trails nearby.

places.name: Barkingham Park
places.note: County dog park in Reedy Creek Park, about 4 acres, fenced.

places.name: Ray's Fetching Meadow
places.note: County dog park in McAlpine Creek Community Park, about 1 acre, fenced, with areas for large and small dogs.

places.name: Shuffletown Dog Park
places.note: County dog park in Shuffletown Park, about 4.6 acres, fenced.

places.name: Swaney Pointe K-9 Park
places.note: County dog park in Ramsey Creek Park, about 4 acres, fenced, with areas for small and large dogs.

places.name: Ninth Street Park dog park
places.note: Small urban dog park in Fourth Ward.

places.name: Clarks Creek Community Park dog park
places.note: Fenced dog park with separate areas for larger and smaller dogs and a shaded walking trail.

places.name: Eastover Park
places.note: Neighborhood park in Eastover with a flat grassy floodplain and walking paths along Briar Creek. Dogs on leash.

places.name: Freedom Park
places.note: Large county park with a lake loop and a link to the Little Sugar Creek Greenway. Dogs on leash.

places.name: Little Sugar Creek Greenway, Midtown access
places.note: Paved greenway along the creek. Leashed dogs are welcome on the path.

places.name: Skiptown
places.note: Off-leash dog park and bar in South End, with daycare, boarding and grooming. Entry is by day pass or membership.

places.name: Lucky Dog Bark and Brew, Charlotte
places.note: Indoor and outdoor off-leash dog park with a sports bar, plus daycare and boarding.

places.name: Lucky Dog Bark and Brew, Steele Creek
places.note: Off-leash dog park with a bar, plus daycare and boarding.

places.name: Lucky Dog Bark and Brew, Cornelius
places.note: Off-leash dog park with a bar, plus daycare and boarding.

places.name: The Dog Bar
places.note: Leash-free bar in NoDa with indoor and outdoor areas. Listed with an annual membership fee per dog.

places.name: NoDa Brewing Company
places.note: Brewery with a dog-friendly patio. Leashed dogs outside.

places.name: The Olde Mecklenburg Brewery
places.note: Brewery with a large biergarten that welcomes pets.

places.name: Brewers at 4001 Yancey
places.note: Brewery with a fenced dog run and three patios.

places.name: Birdsong Brewing Co.
places.note: Taproom that welcomes well-behaved, leashed dogs, with water bowls on request.

places.name: Optimist Hall
places.note: Food hall. Dogs are welcome in the outdoor spaces, including the main courtyard, but not inside the hall.

places.name: The Suffolk Punch
places.note: South End restaurant and brewery listed with a dog-friendly patio.
